task_and_failure: Turn selected application frameworks into an actually working typed ledger with API validation, transactional persistence, migration and a production browser workflow. Resolve incompatible generator and local container startup without substituting a different database.
discovery_provenance: Existing selected engineering application catalog gap; official registry/releases/docs verified before local installation.
license_and_compatibility: Next/React/FastAPI MIT; PostgreSQL License. Dependency licenses and compatible TypeScript5.9.3 generator pin are retained in source review and native locks. No global upgrade.

baseline_and_candidate.baseline: Framework metadata and catalog selection without application execution; not a matched benchmark.
baseline_and_candidate.candidate: Locked, typed local application with native PostgreSQL and observed browser/transaction/restart acceptance.

predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: Invalid requests and stale writes rejected; audit failure rolls back state; migration idempotent; typed production UI creates/updates; exact saved row survives PostgreSQL and app restart.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: No model invocation by qualification commands. Whole-task coordinator/worker usage unknown; no efficiency claim.

runtime_and_platform.isolation: New Git worktree; project-local locks/environments/native PostgreSQL; dedicated ledger_test database; loopback-only owned processes; separate disposable test browsers.

commands: Reviewed native setup/migration/test/build/browser/restart commands enumerated in receipt.json; make verify supplies the repeatable final application checks.

failures_and_skips.reason: TypeScript7.0.2 does not satisfy openapi-typescript7.13.0 peer ^5.x and lacks the JS ts.factory API used by that generator.

Owned container with Documents-directory bind stalled before guest boot. Pending CLI exited after coordinator service intervention with interrupted XPC connection. Image pull succeeded; database was never ready through this path.

limitations: Mac arm64 local synthetic vertical slice only. No WSL/cloud/application production, authenticated users, broker or trading qualification.
The native PostgreSQL source build omits ICU, readline, zlib and TLS; uses UTF-8/C locale, loopback TCP, no Unix socket and local trust authentication. Not a production database profile.
PostgreSQL named-volume container storage was separately tested by the coordinator. This application receipt uses native PostgreSQL; it does not claim the failed bind-mounted container passed.
Initial HTTPX tests passed with upstream deprecation; final tests use verified Pydantic httpx2. One upstream Starlette/AnyIO alias deprecation remains.
Initial CLI browser observation logged missing favicon404; the application icon was added. Final CLI observation has zero console errors or warnings.
The original oracle freeze is retained. Dedicated test-database guarding and unique synthetic browser titles were added before the final freeze without weakening quality assertions.
No model/provider calls were made by the application or qualification commands. Whole coordinator/worker usage is unknown; no token-saving claim.
No production load test, external ingestion, pagination beyond100 rows, independent-host restore or deployment was qualified.

decision_and_scope.scope: Mac arm64 local typed run-ledger application with native PostgreSQL18.6

rollback: Stop owned application and native PostgreSQL first; preserve needed synthetic state/evidence, then retire only the task-owned runtime installation after review. No global settings rollback is necessary.
next_decision_changing_test: Choose the intended real application and user/security/deployment requirements; separately qualify production packaging, access control and independent-host state recovery.
